title: PathRouter: Aligning Rewards with Retrieval Quality in Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: PathRouter：在智能体式图检索增强生成中对齐奖励与检索质量
abstract_en: Agentic GraphRAG trains language-model agents to iteratively retrieve and reason over graph-structured evidence, enabling more accurate and context-aware decision-making by efficiently navigating complex information networks. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning suffers from \textit{\textbf{answer-path reward aliasing}}, where correct answers may come from shortcuts rather than useful evidence paths. It also exhibits \textit{\textbf{search-update ambiguity}}, as scalar trajectory-level feedback does not indicate which retrieval actions to adjust. To mitigate these shortcomings, we present PathRouter, a path-aware training framework for agentic GraphRAG. PathRouter jointly evaluates each trajectory along answer correctness and evidence-path overlap, yielding four trajectory categories with differentiated GRPO advantage scaling that suppresses shortcut reinforcement while preserving evidence-seeking behavior. For evidence-poor trajectories, a frozen gold-evidence teacher provides token-level KL guidance on reasoning and search-query tokens, excluding answer tokens to avoid direct response imitation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks across three model sizes show that PathRouter consistently improves answer F1 and evidence-path overlap, achieving average F1 gains of 3.1 on 3B and 4.9 on 7B models compared to a strong baseline.
abstract_zh: Agentic GraphRAG 通过训练语言模型智能体在图结构证据上迭代检索与推理，使模型能够更高效地浏览复杂信息网络，并做出更准确、上下文感知更强的决策。然而，仅基于最终答案的强化学习存在“答案-路径奖励混淆”（answer-path reward aliasing）：模型可能通过捷径得到正确答案，而非依赖真正有用的证据路径。同时，它还面临“搜索-更新歧义”（search-update ambiguity）：轨迹级标量反馈无法指出哪些检索动作应被调整。为解决这些问题，论文提出 PathRouter，一个面向路径感知的 Agentic GraphRAG 训练框架。PathRouter 同时评估每条轨迹的答案正确性与证据路径重叠度，将轨迹划分为四类，并采用差异化的 GRPO 优势缩放，以抑制对捷径行为的强化，同时保留证据搜索能力。对于证据不足的轨迹，PathRouter 引入冻结的 gold-evidence teacher，对推理与搜索查询 token 提供 token-level KL 指导，并排除答案 token，以避免直接模仿答案。六个问答基准、三种模型规模上的实验表明，PathRouter 持续提升答案 F1 与证据路径重叠度；相较强基线，3B 模型平均 F1 提升 3.1，7B 模型平均提升 4.9。
key_points_zh: 指出 outcome-only RL 在 Agentic GraphRAG 中的两类核心问题：answer-path reward aliasing 与 search-update ambiguity。
提出 PathRouter，将答案正确性与 evidence-path overlap 联合用于轨迹评估，显式区分“答对但路径差”等不同训练信号。
通过四类轨迹的差异化 GRPO advantage scaling，减少对捷径检索行为的奖励，同时鼓励真实证据路径探索。
对证据不足轨迹引入冻结 gold-evidence teacher，在推理与搜索查询 token 上提供 KL guidance，并排除答案 token 以避免答案蒸馏。
在六个 QA benchmarks 和三种模型规模上验证有效性，稳定提升 answer F1 与 evidence-path overlap，7B 模型平均 F1 提升 4.9。

llm_assessment.comment: PathRouter provides a meaningful trajectory-level training signal for agentic GraphRAG, but remains closer to task-specific RAG optimization than general harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: PathRouter 为智能体式 GraphRAG 提供了有意义的轨迹级训练信号，但更接近特定 RAG 优化而非通用运行框架演化。
